new.grammar_mask_timing_scope: Raw worker cpu_mask_seconds is processor-internal wall time. Its interval includes int(input_ids[0,-1]) / .item transfer and possible GPU stream synchronization for the previous token. It excludes the final allowed.to(scores.device) transfer and masked_fill. It is already nested in generation_seconds; it is not pure CPU matcher overhead or an independently measured incremental latency.
